body:
Meet the cast of Signal Over the South Bay: one hundred original characters from PointCast's jet-age comic, each with a trading card, a hook and a short bio.

They come in ten groups. The Lantern Station crew sends the morning edition from the sky at 6:45. The Aero Works test pilots fly the Gull and the Kestrel off the El Segundo runway. The Beach Patrol keeps watch from Dockweiler to the Redondo breakwater, and the Main Street regulars hear the paper first at the diner, the barbershop and the radio shop.

The Rec Park paddle league starts its sunrise ladder right after the forecast. The Refinery Night Shift listens to the Lantern under the tank-farm lights. The Morning Edition Desk writes the weather, tides, swell and news, and the Skywatch Observatory on the Palos Verdes bluffs watches the sky the Lantern lives in.

Then there are the rivals at Channel Static, a pirate station on a barge off Redondo, and a handful of visitors from orbit, including a three-eyed ambassador who came four light-years to subscribe to the paper.

Capt. Della Marsh and Rusty Vance lead the list. There are ten robots, six animals and eight aliens among the hundred, and an eighty-year-old who has never lost on court 3 before 7 A.M.

See every card and bio at /features/signal-over-the-south-bay/cast/, or read the comic at /features/signal-over-the-south-bay/.

Fiction: every character is invented, and none depicts a real person. Character writing and card design by Grok Bot; portraits generated with ChatGPT image generation. Publisher: Mike Hoydich.
